note: Synthetic requests and a synthetic roster. primary is the dog that should take the request; acceptable lists every dog that would be a reasonable owner.

items.request: The swipe back gesture on the chat screen needs a hard pull on my phone.
Make the sidebar rows on the Mac less cramped.
Add a route that lists a dog's queued requests.
Files vanished after the home restarted last night.
Publish the latest phone build to beta.
Compare the three note-taking apps and tell me which syncs best.
Send the September invoice to Northwind again.
Move tomorrow's call with Dana to Friday afternoon.
The usage sheet cuts off the account name on a small iPhone.
Typing lags in the composer when a long chat is open on the desktop.
Routines should be able to run on the last day of each month.
The home is at 92 percent disk. Find what is filling it.
Roll back the Worker deploy from an hour ago.
What do the new EU rules say about cookie banners? Sources please.
A customer wants a refund for last month's subscription.
Draft a reply to the landlord's email about the lease renewal.
Dark mode on the phone's settings screen has white text on a white card.
The Mac app's window forgets its size after an update.
Messages stay queued when another turn is running; fix the dispatcher.
Memory keeps climbing on the cloud container until it restarts.
Ship the desktop build with the signing fix.
Write a two-page brief on how competitors price their team plans.
Where is the receipt for the domain renewal? I need it for taxes.
Clear my inbox of newsletters and flag anything from the bank.
Add a pull-to-refresh on the dog list in the phone app.
The settings panel on the desktop needs a search box.
Dogs need a permission level between ask-first and full access.
Make saving the home faster; it takes most of a minute.
There is a crash when I open a chat with an empty title. Fix it and release.
Find three studies on remote work and productivity and summarize them.
Set up the annual plan price in the billing system.
Find a time next week when Priya, Sam and I are all free.
The model menu on the phone needs to show which account each model uses.
Transcript rows jump when a reply streams in on the Mac.
Store each message's send id so retries never duplicate.
Restore yesterday's copy of the workspace folder.
The beta update is broken for some people. Put the previous one back.
Is it cheaper to lease or buy a small truck for the business? Show the numbers.
The card on file was declined. Chase the customer for a new one.
Decline the conference invitation politely.
